title: Bar chart build
prompt: Animated bar chart: "Revenue by quarter" — Q1 12, Q2 18, Q3 15, Q4 27 ($M). Draw the axis line first, then the bars grow up from the baseline one after another, value labels count/fade in above each bar, Q4 bar is highlighted in an accent color with a little extra pop. Title top-left. Clean and readable.

checklist.text: bars grow from the baseline (size/scale animated, bottom edge fixed)
value labels present (≥4 numeric text layers)
accent highlight on Q4 (≥2 bar colors)
